thread:
Alex: Quick pulse check — changelog cutoff in ~6h for the DevEx release. Need owners/blocks so we can cut the release branch this afternoon.
Priya: Docs lead here. I still need final SDK param names to finish auth snippets. Can adapt either way but prefer final API. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jamie: SDK lead. Found a param rename that slipped through review. Preparing a hotfix branch now. Will open PR in ~20m.
Ben: Sample apps owner. I've updated demos to the new major but waiting on the docs auth example to reconcile. Also a flaky onboarding test popped up in CI for demo-app.
Rachel: QA: seeing intermittent failure in onboarding step (race on setup). I can add extra assertions but prefer a startup retry.
Luis: CI/infra: buildkite backlog at the moment, bumped release pipeline priority. Kicked the stalled matrix job — should retry in ~10m.
ci-bot: buildkite/release-pipeline #215 queued (jobs: lint, unit, e2e). https://buildkite.com/redwood/release-pipeline/builds/215
Alex: Summarize blockers so far: (1) SDK param-rename patch (Jamie), (2) Docs auth snippets (Priya), (3) onboarding race in sample app (Rachel). Anything else to add?
Jamie: Hotfix branch pushed: `hotfix/sdk-auth-param` and PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-sdk/pull/498. Tests green locally, CI now. ETA ~25m.
Priya: I'll wait for #498 to merge before finalizing docs. If it merges sooner I can produce the changelog snippet and update quickstart.
Ben: I'll prepare a small retry wrapper in sample-apps as a temporary mitigation: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/81 — makes init idempotent with 3x short retries.
Rachel: If Ben's PR lands, can we re-run full e2e? I want to confirm the onboarding flake is gone before we tag.
Luis: Yes — once PRs are merged I'll prioritize the full e2e for the release pipeline. Expect it to start in ~35-45m. Will escalate if infra hiccups.
ci-bot: devex-sdk PR #498 CI: unit passed, e2e queued.
Alex: Release process check: after all PRs pass, we cut `release/devex-1.4.1-patch` and tag. Who will perform the cut and publish npm?
Jamie: I'll cut and publish. Commands I use (on release branch):
```
# tag and push
git tag -a v1.4.1 -m "devex SDK patch"
git push origin v1.4.1
# CI-based npm publish
yarn release:ci --npm-token $NPM_TOKEN
```
Ben: After npm publish, I'll bump sample-apps dependency and deploy a smoke demo image to the staging env. I'll coordinate the image tag update.
Priya: I'll draft the changelog bullet and release notes as soon as #498 merges. Ping me for copy edits.
Rachel: Post-deploy I'll run the verification suite and share results. If anything fails, we roll the demo back and pause the announcement.
Luis: Noted. If e2e fails due to infra flakiness we have a manual fallback: we can publish npm manually and do a canary deploy to a single demo pod.
Alex: Proposed timeline: cut branch T+1h, publish T+1h15m, smoke deploy T+1h35m, announce T+2h if green. Sound OK?
Priya: Fine by me. :thumbsup:
Jamie: On it. Will update here when tag is pushed. :shipit:
Ben: Will open the sample-app bump PR once npm artifacts are available.
Rachel: Standby for final verification. :eyes:
ci-bot: release pipeline update: required checks passed for PRs; sample-app e2e pending.
Alex: Thanks all — keep realtime pings in this thread. If timeline slips, shout out asap so we can decide manual vs automated publish.
